response.sql: WITH spatial_with_projects AS ( SELECT ss.boxy, ss.boxz, p.arcregistry, p.fundflux FROM scanspatial ss JOIN projects p ON ss.arcref = p.arcregistry ), funding_stats AS ( SELECT fundflux, AVG(boxy / boxz) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(DISTINCT arcregistry) AS distinct_projects FROM spatial_with_projects WHERE boxy IS NOT NULL AND boxz IS NOT NULL AND boxz != 0 GROUP BY fundflux ), avg_project_count AS ( SELECT AVG(distinct_projects) AS avg_count FROM funding_stats ), kept_sources AS ( SELECT fs.avg_ratio, fs.distinct_projects, ap.avg_count FROM funding_stats fs CROSS JOIN avg_project_count ap WHERE fs.distinct_projects > ap.avg_count ) SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_of_kept_ratios, SUM(distinct_projects) AS total_distinct_projects, AVG(distinct_projects - avg_count) AS avg_excess FROM kept_sources;

assumptions.assumption: Rows with boxz = 0 are excluded to prevent division by zero, though the request only explicitly specifies 'ignoring missing values' (which typically means NULL only).

alternatives.interpretation: If 'ignoring missing values' refers only to NULL and not zero values, omit the `AND boxz != 0` condition. However, this would leave rows where boxy/boxz produces infinity or raises a division error.
